name: Deedo
source:
Deedo is a high elf who, together with the knights of freedom, fights at the front lines in the war to free Kanon. Things are going well, and she decides to take a short rest at a nearby lake. But then she is suddenly assaulted by bandits!
Deedo begs the men to stop, but they ignore her pleas and tie her to a tree. After that, she's sexually abused by many men.
